title: rubiscoN
intro: Find total amount of Rubisco-N in leaves.

sections.name: default
sections.sig:
< default (fraction 0.75 [<fraction>])
               (offset 0 [g N/m2 ])
               (subtract Nf false)
               (subtract Pt false) >

attrs.name: fraction
attrs.doc:
Value description: Equation 6 See also [Boegh et al., 2002]
     Fraction of remaining N in leaves that RuBisCo-N. First structural and luxury
     N may be subtracted, as per the other parameters.

attrs.name: offset
attrs.doc: Subtract this amount of N per LAI.

attrs.name: subtract Nf
attrs.doc: Subtract N corresponding to the non functional concentration in leafs.

attrs.name: subtract Pt
attrs.doc: Subtract N above the critical concentration in leafs.

sections.text:
Standard estimation of RuBisCo N.
   Used by crop default RubiscoN (see 29.1, page 171) .
  < default (fraction 0.75 [<fraction>])
               (offset 0 [g N/m2 ])
               (subtract Nf false)
               (subtract Pt false) >

    fraction: number [<fraction>]
     Parameter (default 0.75)
     Value description: Equation 6 See also [Boegh et al., 2002]
     Fraction of remaining N in leaves that RuBisCo-N. First structural and luxury
     N may be subtracted, as per the other parameters.

    offset: number [g N/m2 ]
     Parameter (default 0)
     Subtract this amount of N per LAI.
    subtract Nf : boolean (see section 4.1.2)
     Parameter (default false)
     Subtract N corresponding to the non functional concentration in leafs.
    subtract Pt: boolean (see section 4.1.2)
     Parameter (default false)
     Subtract N above the critical concentration in leafs.
